dlazy-seedream-4-5 v1.3.3 changelog:

- Updated documentation and metadata for CLI install: now pinned to version 1.2.2 (was 1.0.9).
- Adjusted installation instructions and references to match the new pinned CLI version.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Minor formatting and consistency improvements throughout skill docs.

- Updated npm install instructions and CLI references to use version 1.2.2 (`@dlazy/cli@1.2.2`) instead of `latest`.

- Updated version to 1.3.0
- Made documentation changes in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md
- No changes to usage or command structure
- No new features or breaking changes introduced

- Skill focus changed from video generation to high-quality image generation using Doubao Seedream 4.5.
- Description, usage, and trigger keywords updated to reflect support for text-to-image and image-to-image instead of video tasks.
- Documentation revised for image generation workflows; video-specific instructions removed.
- Outdated file skill-card.md removed.

- Updated CLI installation instructions and metadata to use @dlazy/cli@latest instead of a pinned version.
- Adjusted example commands and descriptions for broader compatibility with future CLI releases.
- Minor corrections to output JSON (`modelId` now "seedream-4.5" instead of "doubao-seedream-4-5").

Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Bumped version to 1.1.1.
- Documentation updates in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md; no changes to commands or functionality.
- No user-facing command, API, or feature changes in this release.

- Added recommendation to use dlazy login (device code flow) for easier authentication.
- Updated authentication instructions to prioritize the login method and clarified manual API key setup as an alternative.
- Corrected the modelId in the output JSON from doubao-seedream-4_5 to doubao-seedream-4-5.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Improved instructions for agent handling of missing API keys: now omits asking the user to "send it," instead instructs saving the provided key and resuming the task.
- Minor text clarity adjustments in the authentication and error-handling sections.
- No changes to CLI options or command functionality.

- Added a dedicated Authentication section with instructions for setting and obtaining your dLazy API key
- Updated CLI install command to use @dlazy/cli@1.0.6
- Clarified API key requirement for all requests via CLI configuration

- Initial release of dlazy-seedream-4.5 skill.
- Generates smooth, high-quality videos from text or images using Doubao Seedream 4.5.
- Provides multiple video customization options: resolution, size, images, and async settings.
- Detailed error handling and user guidance for authorization and credit issues.
- Includes clear usage instructions and command examples.
